extension.description: Monitor Antigravity model quotas, 5-hour & weekly reset timers, AI credits, and active models via the official Antigravity CLI.
command.refresh.title: Refresh Quota Now
command.showMenu.title: Show Quick Menu
command.openDashboard.title: Open Quota Dashboard
command.configureBinaryPath.title: Configure agy Binary Path
command.showLogs.title: Show Diagnostic Logs
viewContainer.title: AG Quota Monitor
view.dashboard.name: Quota Dashboard
config.pauseWhenUnfocused.description: Pause automatic polling while the editor window is unfocused.
config.binaryPath.description: Custom path to the official 'agy' CLI executable. Leave empty for automatic detection.
config.pinnedGroups.description: Quota group names pinned to the status bar (empty shows all groups; ['none'] hides all groups).
config.statusBarFormat.description: Format used to render quota groups in the status bar.
config.statusBarFormat.compact: Short names and compact percentages (e.g. Gemini 90%|38%).
config.showCreditsInStatusBar.descriptio: Show remaining AI credits in the status bar.
config.warningThreshold.description: Remaining percentage below which a quota bucket shows a warning state.
config.criticalThreshold.description: Remaining percentage below which a quota bucket shows a critical error state.
config.notifyOnLowQuota.description: Show a notification when a quota bucket drops below warning, critical, or exhausted thresholds.
config.notifyOnReset.description: Show a notification when a previously exhausted quota bucket resets.
